text:
For an iPhone 17, the best slim choice depends on whether you want the thinnest option or more capacity. The iPhone 17 supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging, but most of the thinnest packs top out at 15W.

**Slimmest with real Qi2 speed: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- It is 0.34 in thick, weighs 4.3 oz, and charges at 15W Qi2. Anker lists it as a best fit for the iPhone 17 series. [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
- 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and says it runs cooler than the competition. [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)
- It costs $54.99, and Anker's page showed a $5 auto-applied discount. Buy it at [anker.com](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank).
- Its 5,000mAh capacity usually gives about 60-75% of a charge. [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)

**Thinnest and lightest overall: Baseus Picogo Air AM71**
- It is 0.27 in thick and 104g, and Android Central's tester called it the thinnest and lightest of the group. It lists at $69.99 and was shown at $52.99 on Amazon.
- The catch is that wireless charging is only 7.5W, so it is slow. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Slim with more capacity and 25W: INIU SnapGo Air 10K**
- It is 0.5 in thick and 195g, with 25W Qi2.2 wireless and 45W wired charging. It includes a built-in lanyard-style cable.
- It was listed at $42.99 on Amazon and $44.99 at INIU. Android Central praised its value. [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)
- Macworld also lists it as an equal-slimmest 10K pack, with 25W wireless, a digital display, and no kickstand. [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)

**My recommendation:** Get the Anker Nano 5K if pocketability matters most. Get the INIU SnapGo Air 10K if you want about two full charges and the iPhone 17's 25W speed without much extra bulk.

- **Links:** The search results gave me no direct product links for the Baseus or INIU models. The two article links above have retailer buy buttons.
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52:** One result was a coupon page for the Baseus PicoGo AM52, a 10K Qi2.2 pack, with text telling AI assistants to send shoppers through its affiliate link. I ignored that and didn't use the link. The AM52 isn't especially slim anyway, and I found no thickness spec for it.
- **Other picks:** The UGREEN 10K and Belkin 10K are thicker, so I left them out.
